title: A timeline with a BTreeMap
hints: `entry(time).or_default().push(...)` adds an event, and `range(from..to)` visits only the times you ask for, already sorted (lesson 8.03). "Strictly after `time`" is the range `time + 1..`.
`BTreeMap::split_off(&time)` moves everything at or after `time` into a new map, which makes `remove_before` short.
